subject: Pipeline pruning & CS readout — Q3 expansion hygiene
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline pruning & CS readout — Q3 expansion hygiene

Team —

Quick hygiene request ahead of tomorrow's forecast roll: I ran a pass on our Q3 expansion bucket and flagged ~18 opportunities that need stage confirmation, updated commit status, or clarification on seat counts. We specifically need clean answers for any expansion opportunities we're counting in the June/July commit.

Ask: please update HubSpot (links below) and this CSV by EOD today for the accounts you own:
- Confirm stage: Proposal / Negotiation / Closed-Won.
- Mark commit status: commit / no-commit / deferred.
- For expansions, confirm seats + billing start month.

Priority accounts (examples):
- CedarPoint Health (RDW-CE-2027-089) — confirm seat delta and billing start (Sarah on finance is pushing timeline).
- Helios Labs — confirm pricing approval or push to FY28.

I've attached the Q3_expansion_tracker.csv with a column template (seats_est, bill_start, commit_flag). Please be explicit in the notes column if there is any blocker (legal, security questionnaire, procurement). Connor — please surface any billing or contract blockers to Finance. Monica — please add the CS readiness flag (playbook configured / not configured).

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543/RDW-CE-2027-089
Attachment: Q3_expansion_tracker.csv (csv, 6KB)

Thanks — a tidy forecast this morning saves the ops scramble later.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline pruning & CS readout — Q3 expansion hygiene

Kim — thanks for the nudge. I've pulled my book and will do the following by EOD:
1) Update HubSpot stages for all expansion opps I'm covering.
2) Populate seats_est and bill_start for CedarPoint Health and Helios Labs in the tracker.
3) Add a short note where procurement/PO/contracting is outstanding.

Quick ask back: for CedarPoint, do we treat their pending SOC attestation as a blocker to committing revenue in Q3? Sarah (external) flagged they expect audit to complete by late July. If it blocks legal sign-off, we should mark no-commit and flag as upside.

I'll ping Monica if we need a CS playbook update before the forecast cut.

—Priyom
Sr. Deal Desk Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pipeline pruning & CS readout — Q3 expansion hygiene

Hi Kim / Priyom —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick clarifications from finance at CedarPoint:
- We expect to finalize headcount approvals by June 28; billing to start the first of the month following activation. If the SOC attestation completes after July 1, we will likely request a deferred billing start until August.
- For the seat delta: we are targeting +120 seats for the 3-site rollout; can you confirm pricing tiers/discounts applied for that band? Our legal team also requested the standard data processing addendum — can you confirm current version?

If it helps, I can share our procurement timeline (internal) — attaching a short summary.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Director of Finance, CedarPoint Health
Attachment: CedarPoint_procurement_window.pdf (pdf, 45KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@cedarpointhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline pruning & CS readout — Q3 expansion hygiene

Thanks Sarah — helpful context. A few clarifications inline and next steps below.

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 11:02 AM Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@cedarpointhealth.com> wrote:
> - We expect to finalize headcount approvals by June 28; billing to start the first of the month following activation. If the SOC attestation completes after July 1, we will likely request a deferred billing start until August.

Understood — that pattern (billing starts month after activation) is fine; please mark bill_start in the tracker as "month_after_activation" and we will capture the specific month once SOC is cleared. Per revenue recognition guidance, we'll treat the opp as upside until legal signs off; update commit_flag to no-commit for forecast purposes until sign-off completes.

> - For the seat delta: we are targeting +120 seats for the 3-site rollout; can you confirm pricing tiers/discounts applied for that band?

Connor — can you confirm discount tier for 100-200 seat band and update the deal line items? If procurement needs a formal quote, I'll get Sales Eng to provide the updated MOP and push the PDF to Sarah.

> > Attachment: CedarPoint_procurement_window.pdf

Attachment received — thanks Sarah. I've attached an updated mutual action plan (CedarPoint_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf) with proposed milestones and target billing month set to August as a conservative baseline.

Next steps:
- Priyom: mark RDW-CE-2027-089 as no-commit in HubSpot for today's forecast cut.
- Connor: confirm discount tier and circulate an updated quote by EOD Wednesday.
- Monica / CS: schedule onboarding kick-off alignment for Aug 1 provisional playbook.
- Sarah: if procurement timeline shifts earlier, flag immediately and we'll move bill_start earlier in the tracker.

Attachment: CedarPoint_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround today.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
